content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected on /v1/chat and increased latency on /v1/embeddings. Error spike started 2024-10-27T15:12:01Z. Routing saturation suspected. Pager -> @sara_oncall

sara_oncall: I'm paged, grabbing context. @raj_ops can you pull the recent routing logs and the per-route qps histogram?

raj_ops: pulling logs now. seeing sustained 95th latency on embeddings ~1.8s (baseline 0.6s). Chat errors are 502s on a subset of backends (gpu-pool-7). Rerank jobs queued up large - backlog 18k.

sara_oncall: ok. immediate mitigations we can do: 1) tighten chat public tier qps to reduce tail pressure; 2) temporarily disable rerank for non-enterprise routes; 3) bump embeddings per-route quota for a small set of paying customers who've reported production errors. propose commands below, will run after ack.

kevin_pd: ack. prioritize customer impact: which customers affected?

maria_support: CS reports impact on: cust-alpha (high), cust-beta (medium), cust-gamma (low). cust-alpha is on Dedicated, experiencing latency for embeddings-based features.

sara_oncall: plan of action (short):
- Apply route-specific qps caps for /v1/chat (public/free) to 50 qps.
- Increase route quota for /v1/embeddings for cust-alpha to 400 qps (temporary override).
- Disable /v1/rerank for non-enterprise routes (will reduce write pressure).
- Start a canary config deploy to 10% of traffic, watch 1 min, then rollout.

raj_ops: commands I'm about to run:

```
# reduce chat public qps (route-level override)
redwoodctl routes update --path /v1/chat --set limits.free_qps=50 --dry-run=false

# set customer-specific embedding quota
redwoodctl quotas set --customer cust-alpha --route /v1/embeddings --qps 400 --duration 60m

# disable rerank for non-enterprise
redwoodctl routes update --path /v1/rerank --set enabled=false --scope non-enterprise
```

sara_oncall: deploy the first one (chat qps) now. I'll watch metrics.

raj_ops: applied chat qps cap. infra-bot: config-deploy started id=cfg-20241027-001. canary -> 10% traffic.

infra-bot: :gear: Config deploy cfg-20241027-001: canary 10% applied to edge cluster eu-west-1. No immediate errors.

maria_support: ping from cust-alpha: embeddings latency dropping a bit but still elevated. they asked if we can prioritize them.

sara_oncall: applying customer override for cust-alpha now. raj_ops you have the token to run the quota bump? I'll coordinate.

raj_ops: applied quotas for cust-alpha -> 400 qps for 60m. infra-bot: quota-change id=q-20241027-002 applied.

infra-bot: quota-change q-20241027-002: cust-alpha /v1/embeddings qps=400 ttl=3600s

kevin_pd: disabling rerank for non-enterprise now to free up workers.

raj_ops: applied rerank disable. infra-bot: config-deploy cfg-20241027-002: /v1/rerank.enabled=false for scope non-enterprise.

infra-bot: cfg-20241027-002 deployed. rerank disabled for non-enterprise routes.

sara_oncall: summary so far:
- chat public qps cap -> 50 (canary->full rollout in progress)
- cust-alpha embeddings bumped to 400 qps (60m)
- rerank disabled for non-enterprise

Initial impact: chat error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in 3m after qps cap. embeddings latency p95 improved to 1.1s for cust-alpha within 2m of bump. Rerank backlog decreased 30% after disable.

maria_support: continuing customer outreach. cust-beta still reporting intermittent failures for chat.

sara_oncall: cust-beta is a free-tier heavy user. we'll add a route-specific header-based filter to throttle aggressive API key. raj_ops please identify top 5 api-keys by qps on /v1/chat.

raj_ops: top offenders found: key-zzz, key-yyy, key-xxx. prepared throttles: key-zzz -> 10 qps, key-yyy -> 20 qps, key-xxx -> 5 qps.

sara_oncall: apply throttles for those keys now. Also create short-lived quota for paid-tier to preserve UX for paid customers.

raj_ops: applied key throttles. infra-bot: key-limit-change kc-20241027-003 applied.

infra-bot: kc-20241027-003: key-zzz=10qps, key-yyy=20qps, key-xxx=5qps

kevin_pd: adding to post-incident actions: better per-route prioritization policy and dynamic budget shifting during pressure. We need automated escalation to bump dedicated customers before global changes.

sara_oncall: on-call handoff: I need to leave in 18m. handing off to @kevin_pd for 18:30UTC follow-up and customer comms. kevin, can you take the 30m monitoring window and confirm stability?

kevin_pd: taking handoff. I'll monitor dashboards and coordinate rollback plan.

maria_support: customer notes: cust-alpha says feature recovery is acceptable. cust-beta still needs follow-up; we plan an incident summary email.

raj_ops: current metrics now: overall chat errors down to 3.2%, embeddings p95 across platform 0.9s (was 1.8s). Rerank workers freed = 24 instances.

sara_oncall: good. moving to recovery -> partial mitigation. Next steps:
- Keep cust-alpha quota for 60m, then review logs and revert if stable.
- Keep rerank disabled for non-enterprise for 2 hours, then re-enable during low-traffic window with throttles.
- Postmortem to include root cause hypothesis: routing imbalance + one backend pool (gpu-pool-7) overloaded by rerank batching.

kevin_pd: creating incident thread in postmortems later. For now, who will run the formal customer impact assessment (SLA hours + feature degradation)? @maria_support + @sara_oncall?

maria_support: I'll collect impacted customers and durations and draft the impact table. sara, can you export trace ids for cust-alpha during window 15:05-15:30Z?

sara_oncall: will export and drop in the incident folder. exporting now... done. file: s3://redwood-incident-exports/20241027/1719504321-traces.json

raj_ops: small note: we added three route-specific rules, documenting them here for PD: 

```
# summary of temporary route overrides
/v1/chat: default.free_qps=50, key-throttles=[key-zzz:10,key-yyy:20,key-xxx:5]
/v1/embeddings: cust-alpha qps=400 ttl=60m
/v1/rerank: enabled=false scope=non-enterprise ttl=120m
```

kevin_pd: noting action items now:
- raj_ops: persist config changes as temporary flags and tag for auto-revert if not confirmed in 2h
- sara_oncall: export traces & handoff notes (in progress)
- maria_support: compile customer impact table and draft comms
- infra: investigate gpu-pool-7 scheduling and rerank job batching

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: All temporary flags tagged: incident-1719504321, auto-revert=120m

sara_oncall: handing over live monitor to kevin. leaving channel now. thanks team :pray:

kevin_pd: I'll keep watch. if errors creep above 8% or embeddings p95 >1.5s, alert escalation to SRE.

maria_support: confirmed cust-alpha happy for now. cust-beta awaiting follow-up.

raj_ops: logs show no new 502s from gpu-pool-7 in the last 6m. continuing health checks every 1m.

infra-bot: incident note appended to ticket INC-20241027-1719504321. next update in 30m or on condition.

kevin_pd: closing active mitigation messages. recording this thread as the canonical incident timeline for initial mitigation. will add to postmortem later.

kevin_pd: last check-in (18:48UTC): system stable. leaving monitoring to infra watch. closing pager for now.
